title: ItemScan
description: An ultra-fast, multi-threaded item and loot scanner that searches your entire world without lagging the server.
body:
ItemScan is a highly optimized Minecraft server plugin that allows admins to search their entire world for specific items or unopened loot chests.

Unlike other plugins that cause massive server lag by loading thousands of chunks, ItemScan reads the raw .mca region files directly from your disk using all your CPU cores. This makes it 20x to 100x faster than traditional scanners and causes zero TPS drops!

# Commands:

- /scan - Scans for the item you are holding.
- /scan name / enchant / lore - Filter by custom names, enchants, or lore.
- /scan loot - Finds all unopened generated loot chests in your world.
- /scan cancel - Stops an ongoing scan.
